title: Return to a complete private briefing without losing new activity
description: Independent commanders inspect their authorized production history. A returning commander recovers a paged period, keeps their reading position when new activity arrives, saves only the reviewed period and inspects the remaining report. Visits belong to authoritative player identities. The development mock provider uses real encrypted commands and grants. Domain clocks and actual service delivery are explicitly labelled controls, not hosted certification. Interrupted visit and managed-key stories remain separate coverage.
